title: Money Saved by Cutting Back
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vice:log type=nicotine
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(count) as uses by _time
| eventstats max(uses) as baseline
| eval avoided=baseline-uses, saved=round(avoided*0.60,2)
| sort - _time
description: Estimates the money you have saved each month by using less than your peak, turning willpower into cash.
value: A pounds-saved figure is often the most motivating number of all, making the benefit of cutting back concrete.
implementation: Ingest usage counts into `index=personal`; estimate monthly savings against your peak usage.
visualization: Column chart of estimated monthly savings.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates how much money you have saved by cutting back on a habit, turning willpower into real cash.
